global_issues.title: Oil Prices Retreat Sharply on Easing Middle East Concerns
global_issues.note: Confirmed by multiple sources: Brent/WTI spiked toward $108 around Sept 10 on US-Israel-Iran conflict, then fell for four straight sessions, dropping below $98-100 by Sept 21 on diplomatic de-escalation hopes. Directionally and temporally consistent with briefing.

global_issues.title: Korea Chip Exports Hit Record on AI Demand Despite Controls
global_issues.note: Confirmed: South Korea's first-20-days-of-September exports hit $71.4B with semiconductor exports at a record $34.1B (+259% YoY), chips at 47.8% of total exports — matches briefing numbers exactly.

global_issues.title: Fed Officials Signal More Rate Hikes Needed as 2Y Yield Hits Multi-Year High

grok_report.summary: The briefing's global issues (oil retreat, Korea chip export record) are accurately and precisely sourced, but it omits the actually-completed Sept 16 Fed rate hike and, more importantly, misses the Bessent US-China trade-talks headline that was a key driver of Sept 21's broad market rally. The 'yellow/cautious' mood framing understates how strongly bullish the actual session was (record Nasdaq close, best day in weeks), while sector rotation calls and most individual stock moves (META/Muse surge, chip strength) are directionally correct with only minor price/percentage discrepancies likely due to data-source timing.
